sentences.text:
Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc-Lko:13823
Court No. - 12

Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 1721 of 2024
Applicant :- Pradeep Kumar
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

Counsel for Applicant :- Sandhya Devi,Babita Singh,Neha Chaurasia
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA and perused the record.
2. The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in FIR No.0325 of 2023, under Section 498A, 304B IPC & Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, P.S. Tandiyawan, District Hardoi.
3. In terms of the FIR it was alleged that the daughter of the informant was married to the applicant around two years ago.
Subsequently, on 27.06.2023, the daughter was hanged to death.

Learned counsel for the applicant draws my attention to the post-mortem report which indicates cause of death as ante mortem hanging and apart from the ligature mark, no other injuries are observed on the body of the deceased.
It is further argued that during trial, the informant has turned hostile and has stated that the victim has committed suicide because of some medical problems.

4. Learned AGA has opposed the bail application.
5. In view of the said statement, a case for bail is made out, particularly, when the applicant is in custody since 01.07.2023 and has no criminal history.
In view thereof, the application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant Pradeep Kumar be released on bail in aforesaid FIR number on his furnishing a personal bond with two sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 16.2.2024 nishant  Pradeep Kumar vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.
